name: halloween-town
author: Lil Art
description: Halloween Town: a solo or party Halloween instance in a haunted, night-time Nifflheim. Talk to Casper in Nifflheim (185, 190), pick a moon (Blue Moon 90+, Blood Moon 100-199, Eclipse 200+), stop Blair the witch across three hordes and four bosses, and trade Halloween Coins with the Halloween Exchanger (180, 191).
